  extremes occur.  After subtracting the arithmetic ray and normalizing

  positive throughout the normalized period range.  This does not sign
  interior profiles because the phase functional is nonlinear in the
  increments.  Direct facet/vertex/primitivity/phase-multiset/scope audit:

- [MATH_THEOREM_CYCLIC_APERY_LAG_VARIANCE_WEIGHTED_GINI_AND_ANTIPODAL_NOGO_20260805.md](MATH_THEOREM_CYCLIC_APERY_LAG_VARIANCE_WEIGHTED_GINI_AND_ANTIPODAL_NOGO_20260805.md),
  SHA `aad919ad5958fa72da98f1762425c0c1c22c958fc0bc622806f5eb29d4f9af80`,
  recasts cyclic subadditivity as the statement that one distinguished
  increment prefix maximizes every cyclic window length simultaneously.
  For lag `j`, the difference variable lies in
  `[-e(-j),e(j)]`; the sharp mean-zero interval estimate yields
  `Var(e) <= (4g)^(-1) sum_j (e(j)+e(-j)) G_j`, where `G_j` is the lag
  Gini difference.  This is equality for the unit sawtooth.  The tempting
  antipodal-product closure is false: the valid capped profiles
  `e_M(j)=min(j,M)` have antipodal average
  `M^2(1-M/g)`, exceeding `(2/3)mu(mu+1)` for fixed `M>=3` and large
  `g`.  The proof-safe new analytic target is the weighted-Gini inequality,
  not the bare antipodal convolution bound.

- [MATH_THEOREM_CONFIGURATION_ROOT_LATTICE_BUFFERED_EXACT_ROUNDING_20260805.md](MATH_THEOREM_CONFIGURATION_ROOT_LATTICE_BUFFERED_EXACT_ROUNDING_20260805.md),
  SHA `96740e6bfca81502bffe01209e442cb03848d4469e40f5e6170840a7294d33ce`,
  proves an exact finite **anonymous tail-rounding** theorem.  The two
  configurations `(j)` and `(j-1,1)` differ by `e_1-e_j`; these vectors form
  a `Z`-basis of the zero-work root lattice.  An extreme residual
  configuration point with at most `D` active tail rows has at most `D`
  split jobs, and rounding their supported configurations creates integral
  error `|e_j|<=D L_max/j`.  A labelled two-state bank with
  `R_j=ceil(D L_max/j)` jobs in each state cancels that error exactly at the
  original depth.  The bank has `O(D L_max log D)` jobs and
  `O(D^2 L_max)` work.

  The exact buffered-fractional-interior dual is

  `S_J(theta)>=Pi_G(theta)` for every nonnegative price, where `Pi_G` is the
  bank jobs' opportunity cost relative to their cheapest configurations.
  It is not enough to price the aggregate bank tail `B` alone.  Under
  `min theta=0,max theta=1`, `Pi_G<=2 sum_j jR_j`, so a normalized slack
  density of order the Boolean width would dominate the polynomial bank;
  bare all-price nonnegativity does not.

  Exact aggregate tails imply only an anonymous equal-length socket
  bijection.  They do not imply named containment Hall at zero reserve or a
  protected chronology.  Thus `BFI_D` removes same-depth anonymous rounding
  exceptions but does not yet prove a named lower collar, `C=0`,
  `B(k)+O(1)`, or exact equality.  Independent-GO-after-correction audit:
  [MATH_AUDIT_CONFIGURATION_ROOT_LATTICE_BUFFERED_EXACT_ROUNDING_INDEPENDENT_20260805.md](MATH_AUDIT_CONFIGURATION_ROOT_LATTICE_BUFFERED_EXACT_ROUNDING_INDEPENDENT_20260805.md),
  SHA `c343f2560ff5d0d935b54eeda82b6bcd2944e2de99f38ec4d5d3b492fcac1b12`.

  `zeta` of the Rayleigh kernel.  Every negative clock has a negative

- [MATH_THEOREM_H3_NONLEXICAL_PROTECTED_RADO_FOREST_AND_TRANSPARENT_CONNECTOR_GATE_20260801.md](MATH_THEOREM_H3_NONLEXICAL_PROTECTED_RADO_FOREST_AND_TRANSPARENT_CONNECTOR_GATE_20260801.md)
  freezes the surviving nonlexical host theorem.  Its SCD statement has three
  exact scopes: distinct occurrence-labelled targets suffice for bounded
  forced marks; fully marked distinct-root prefixes require vertex
  disjointness; and the descending-linear-forest criterion belongs only to
  unlabelled fragments.  On the aligned/private face, two nested prescribed
  Rado transversals build the upper forest and then choose the fixed matching,
  final component and connector seams.  Portal banks are handled by
  contraction.  Three crossing source/destination/provider rows, physical
  linear forests and the Boolean fractional point give the sharp obstructions
  outside that face.

  The reset packet is locally complete.  The resident return rail gives a
  simple `4d+2`-root complete-reversal cycle with exact derivative and
  cyclic-interval inventories, residence and the literal one-attachment/two-
  predecessor signature.  Although a bare cut loses `d(2d-1)` unique packet
  values, the canonical `d`-overlap restores every owner and all lower/middle
  targets.  Its exact leave is two upper Ferrers triangles, total `d(d+1)`,
  covered by explicit `2d`- and `3d`-owner banks.  Both ends of both banks
  are clipped.  A standalone cyclic host therefore needs four collars: when
  a resource-simple four-collar realization is supplied, the banks reserve
  at most `9d` ambient owners and the packet-plus-bank incidence footprint
  is `26d-2`, giving the conditional threshold `m>=26d`.  The smaller `7d`,
  `22d-2`, `m>=22d` ledger requires two certified ambient continuations.
  Before residence completion, the raw packet-plus-bank forest has
  `18d-2` incidence edges and the unconditional owner/lower-q1 factor
  projection at `m>=18d`.  Upper surjectivity, joining, exterior
  cross-windows and the terminal compiler are not supplied.

  The theorem now gives the exact alternative to the Catalan connector tree.
  In one oriented upper-exact resident cycle factor, a guarded matching of
  `s` literal `H2->H3` q-port packets reduces `qs` components to `s` while
  preserving coefficient-one immediate resources, residence and setwise
  upper support.  A recursive no-split schedule exists exactly when its
  component merge forest carries parent-ready occurrence-labelled sockets,
  consistent relative phases, surviving upper/exterior tickets and one
  terminal compiler.  At reset arity `q=2(d+1)`, one state has
  `4(d+1)^2` atoms and the old/new catalogue has
  `2(d+1)(2d+3)` atoms.  A hierarchy from `c` to `r` components uses
  `(c-r)/(2d+1)` packets.  The displayed support totals are formal
  full-standard-packet censuses: the literal packet itself has height one.

  Mixed `q=3,4` arithmetic removes the fixed-arity residue.  The optimal
  q4-dominant serial loose comb reaches one component from every `c!=2`,
  needs only the relay interfaces `3->3`, `3->4`, `4->4`, and has formal
  core cost below `(8/3)(d+1)c`.  Since
  `Cat_m=2W/(m+1)`, any realization with `O(d)` new guarded support per node
  uses `O(Cat_m*d)=O(W/sqrt(m))=o(W)` owners.  The missing theorem is a
  hereditary all-width cut signature at each relay socket, not scalar
  capacity.

  A second exact route selects a short-run transversal jointly with a
  coloured endpoint-packet matching, contracts the resulting resident paths,
  and rejoins them.  If the exchange labels satisfy the lag-spread bound
  `M_t<=AW/k` for `1<=t<=d`, the residence-cut density is at most `Ad/k`; if
  each short-run count is `O(Cat_m)`, the atom count is `O(Cat_m*d)`.
  Neither estimate selects an endpoint-feasible transversal.  The missing
  joint Boolean expansion theorem must find, among minimum or priced
  near-minimum cuts, one whose state-expanded packet hypergraph passes the
  Aharoni--Haxell resource row, shared orientations and connectivity.  A
  linear packing of disjoint defect intervals instead forces even the raw
  cut density to be bounded away from zero.  Private `d`-owner collars at
  every cut would cost `Theta(W)` at `d=Theta(sqrt(k))`, so the seams must be
  native or share guards; the corrected `13d+2` four-boundary module is only
  one terminal charge.

  At `k=17` the independently verified 29-owner protected factor closes all
  owners, lower q1 colours and rank-10 targets in seven components.  Its
  exact residence transversal is 3,807 edges, or
  `0.15660... W = 0.8874...(d/k) W`, and avoids all protected internal gaps.
  The deterministic rightmost-greedy protected-gap-avoiding optimum emitted
  by the cited audit demonstrates
  why the cut and rejoin choices cannot be sequential.  Its raw 56,790-seam
  atlas has perfect two-shore projections, but the relaxed necessary
  residence atlas has only 13,174 seams, 1,289 isolated deleted colours,
  368 zero-out blocks and 368 zero-in blocks, with block--colour rank only
  2,518/3,807.  Thus ordinary seams cannot rejoin that fixed decomposition,
  even before the 1,806 rank-11--13 targets and terminal compiler.  Another
  optimum, a priced nonminimum cut, interior rethreading or resident seam
  gadgets remains open.

  The raw `795` forced-seam union is not a resident core: all `281`
  unique-lower members are incumbent cut edges, and private short-run collars
  forbid reinserting any edge of a minimum transversal.  Forty-six of those
  edges are also the sole raw rank-ten restorers.  The newer two-cut union
  atlas supplies every singleton row, but this is prospective support rather
  than one compatible matching; the exact next theorem is joint integral
  cut/split/seam selection.

  The older SCD segmentation has an exact lower square but no upper Euler
  identity.  Cutting `t` edges gives `P=Cat_m+t` pieces and exactly `P` raw
  missing lower colours, whereas its complete upper debt is
  `H=t+A(F)+B_F(D)`.  Hence `P-H=Cat_m-A-B_D` depends on deep last-witness
  casualties.  At the same `m=9,d=3,t=1419,P=6281`, the canonical cut has
  gap `8` while another authenticated minimum cut has gap `226`; refinement
  fixtures even have `H>P`.  The whole unchanged minimum-fragment face is
  rank-ten impossible, so the live SCD route is a nonminimum recut, a closed
  resident socket/ear, or an interior rethread.

  Once every two-cut/augmenter column closes its child casualties, boundary
  state, decks, roots, protected resources and topology inside one functional
  site, the exact unrepaired-primary-target count is
  `max_X(|X|-|N(X)|)`.  Singleton support can still leave defect `|Z|-1`.
  If topology is not sealed, the exact object is target--site packet matching
  plus literal degree/graphic cuts.  Bounded-radius alternating closure gives
  local repair, but a bidiagonal chain shows that two-cut locality and global
  matchability can require a `Theta(|Z|)` exchange.  No generic matroid is
  inferred.

  The literal dense refinement makes this rebase concrete.  Its 7,612 pieces
  have no relaxed-resident unoriented endpoint or deleted-lower singleton
  zero and perfect physical unoriented `TH`, `TC`, and `CH` projections.  Nevertheless
  187 old-outer-endpoint pieces have incoming support only in one orientation
  and outgoing support only in the other, so the exact common-orientation q1
  CNF is unit-UNSAT; 78 of 5,094 rank-ten casualties also have no
  relaxed-resident atomic provider.  A protected sparse-zero theorem is
  conditional: match defects to disjoint closed absorber sites and contract
  them inside an already synchronized functional core `G`.  If at most `h`
  balanced pairs are removed, uniform robustness is exactly
  `|N_G(X)|>=min(N,|X|+h)` for every nonempty `X`.  Constant-support `o(N)`
  banks then cost `o(N)`; facet-scale packets need `d|Z|=o(N)`.  This fixed
  bank cannot instantiate the theorem.

  The new socket lemma gives the exact refinement rebase.  Compatibility is
  undirected; old socket edges and rank-ten providers persist; each new cut
  self-supplies its two sockets, lower colour and lost factor-upper value.
  A raw witness-edge cover with allowed first inward gaps therefore repairs
  singleton support in at most two cuts per witness, conditionally at most
  `530` for the first `187+78` bank.  More strongly, any already selected
  coloured q1 socket matching lifts canonically through all later pure cuts;
  after contracting the self-edges, the functional core and component
  topology are unchanged, and the expanded physical owner word is identical.
  This is the zero-damage `a=0` absorber case.

  Cut choice has now produced a second 7,612-piece bank with zero isolated
  sockets and zero rank-ten provider rows.  It is still q1-UNSAT: a verified
  four-seam bow tie on three pieces and two lower colours defeats the joint
  coloured matching although every pair projection passes.  Hence the live
  bounded theorem is rank improvement, not singleton cover.  With
  `delta_3=P-nu_3`, pure refinement gives nonincreasing `delta_3`; if every
  positive-defect state has an allowed `q0`-cut improving bundle, at most
  `q0*delta_3` cuts reach a selector.  The bounded `q0` assertion is open and
  essential.  One global cut change already kills the first bow tie without
  reopening singleton rows, but the rebuilt formula returns a second tiny
  core; core-breaking is not yet matching-rank improvement.  Once a selector exists, every subsequent pure refinement
  preserves it canonically; boundary-changing packets alone require robust
  Hall.

  The rank-improvement row is now exact.  For an incumbent protected seam

  corollaries isolate the common upper-service/run-state lemma still needed
  at the separate AD factor's 1,739-service scale.  The companion
  [`component-neutral ledger`](MATH_LEMMA_K17_COMPONENT_NEUTRAL_U_INSERTION_LEDGER_20260731.md)
  records the all-r proof and strict artifact scopes.  Current finite status
  is also reconciled: the 736-bank has a colour/full-DFA degree cover and a
  safe component-reducing switch, while the distributed tripleflow lower
  factor has 989 components and 9,103 upper holes.  Neither is a K17 word.
  Both notes passed independent adversarial audits; SHAs are

  cut is recreated by a new cross-block ladder.  The interval transversal
  number, rather than average multiplicity, is the exact black-box
  redundancy radius.  The note derives the Pascal two-seam multiplicity
  condition, fixed-window seam bounds, and a shore-separated K17 rethread
  interface.  Two audited central-Johnson counterfamilies refute any
  q1-data-only safe-reroot or same-deck rethread lemma, while explicitly
  leaving the full-Pascal existence question open.  SHA
  `f9b88dd8a4146f68f4b5efa23e71339007b73a176728b065e915ffe73d490381`.

## Resolved `k=15` frontier (older descent history retained below)

The authoritative conclusion is `nu(15)=6438`, proved by the certificate at
the top of this index.  The Hall-29 through Hall-19 material below records the
historical route and remains useful for its local lemmas, but its numerical
frontier is superseded.

The target is `B(15)=6438`.  Starting from the former Hall-29 carrier, four
audited shadow-safe segment braids reach the authoritative Hall-25 base.
Certified neutral-then-improving pairs then reach Hall 24, Hall 23, Hall 22,
Hall 21, Hall 20, and now Hall 19, while retaining six zero-candidate targets.
The first two routers compress positive DM components before splitting them.
The Hall-20-to-Hall-19 route exhibits a different mechanism: a neutral braid
fuses two gap-one native bases into a `321/319` two-root native forest while
leaving a remote `161/160` component's abstract profile unchanged; the next
braid duplicates a common physical profile and discharges that remote
component.  The active Hall-19 shore is `516/497`: six isolated `1/0` zeros,
eleven positive-degree gap-one native bases, and one positive-degree
`321/319` gap-two native forest.  Thus its exact deficit is
`19=6+13`, with the thirteen congestion units lying in twelve components.
One common controller realizes 658 literal pins on the former 677-target
Hall-20 shore.  A common word for a full 16,364-edge matching and the
remaining Hall-19 deficit are still open.

  residence-preserving rebundling theorem.  The relabeled-MSW barycentre has
  edge weight `1/28` and lower load `9/7`, while an explicit regular integral
  excess vector closes all marginal objections.  The exact missing theorem
  is `WCR(15,7): A_7 z=1, A_6 z>=1` with integral `z`, or alternatively the
  independently scoped fixed-overlay frame-circulation lemma.  Both are
  more restrictive sufficient statements whose converses are unproved;
  neither unrestricted RTR nor an architecture-wide no-go is claimed.

- [MATH_THEOREM_K_ALLK_SCARCE_FIRST_PORT_HALL_AND_POSITIVE_DENSITY_COMPILER_20260730.md](MATH_THEOREM_K_ALLK_SCARCE_FIRST_PORT_HALL_AND_POSITIVE_DENSITY_COMPILER_20260730.md)
  gives the pure-mathematics all-`k` successor to the atomic lopsided
  compiler theorem.  It proves the exact canonical run-component/positive-

  remaining gate is a positive-density PBBS/Pascal port or target-tiling
  construction; no unconditional coefficient-one claim is made.

  unconditional improvement over the existing `O(sqrt(log k))W` theorem is
  claimed.

  audits the published Gregor--Mütze recursion at the exact directed-repair
  interface.  Lemmas 12--13 are trimming/subsequence lemmas; the displayed
  adjacent-level splice is Theorem 15.  At the even-central boundary a
  common upper-block/lower-tight refinement requires exactly

  the displayed one-port splice creates exactly one.  The resulting Hall
  deficiency is `Cat_m-1`, independent of the child cycles and their
  coordinate permutations.  The direct-step union multiset is nevertheless
  preserved exactly.

  A viable replacement must apply one compatible Pascal square to every
  direct child edge.  Under floor marginals this is an exact
  `Cat_m x Cat_m x Cat_m` occurrence-labelled matching core; literal
  cap-two additionally needs one-cycle topology and adjacency of every
  direct edge to its equal-union distinguished edge.  A proved
  block-coherent closure lemma propagates that adjacency when the central

  rows are `(q-1)t+B<=A_(d-1)`, `dt+B<=L-H`, and
  `qt+B<=n_(c+2)`, in addition to `t<=A_(d+1)`.  Canonically
  `A_(d-1)/A_(d+1)->1`, so a buffered inventory has scale at most
  `Theta(W/q^2)`; the reading `t=A_(d+1)=Theta(W/q)` is impossible, and it
  separately violates the rank-`(c+2)` row by the limiting factor `pi/2`.

  hyperedge gives the exact weighted conflict load
  `Gamma=q^2/W+1/K_c+1/K_(c+1)+sum_j q^2/K_(c+j)`.  A direct joint greedy
  theorem supplies every `t` with `(t-1)Gamma<1`, hence every candidate-level

  use still requires the primitive/short-buffer inventory and every ledger
  row, especially `dt+B<=L-H`.  A
  preused bank is allowed by the single explicit row
  `Psi+(t-1)Gamma<1`.

  The remaining factor-`q` gap is not closed by a standard nibble citation.
  For `q>=5` and nested high targets `P` of rank `r-2` and `Q=P+x` of rank `r-1`, the exact
  relative codegree is `deg(P,Q)/deg(Q)=2/(r-1)`.  Since a high-deck edge has
  size `R=q(q-2)`, one has `R deg(P,Q)/deg(Q)->pi/2`.  For
  maximum degree `D=X_0q/K_(c+2)`, the sharper obstruction is
  `R Delta_2/D >= 2q(q-2)K_(c+2)/((r-1)K_(r-1)) ->
  (pi/2)e^(-pi/4)>0`; the putative
  `O(q^4/W^2)` independent-pair estimate is false, and fixed-uniformity
  Roedl--Pippenger does not transfer to this diagonal regime.  A specialized
  chain-aware `q`-round nibble or an SCD/chain contraction is still open.

# 2026-08-02 — Prime-slope frame local amplifier and pointed-flag boundary

- [MATH_THEOREM_FACET_PRIME_SLOPE_FRAME_Q_AMPLIFIER_20260802.md](MATH_THEOREM_FACET_PRIME_SLOPE_FRAME_Q_AMPLIFIER_20260802.md)
  gives an unconditional local factor-`q` amplifier.  For a prime
  `q/3-1<p<2q/3`, put `s=q-p` and use the `(p-1)/2` nonzero slopes of
  `F_p` modulo sign on one common `p`-set, with a disjoint private `s`-set
  for every slope.  Two private tags inserted in nonadjacent gaps force
  every common-pool interval to have length between `2` and `p-2`.  The
  translation-invariant moment
  `Phi(S)=|S|sum(S^2)-sum(S)^2` then recovers its progression slope up to
  sign.  Consequently all modules in the frame have distinct owners and
  named targets at every rank, including the two separately labelled low
  ranks.

  One frame has `m=(p-1)/2=Theta(q)` modules, uses at most
  `c+q+q^2/8<=k` coordinates canonically, and has exact resource counts
  `mq` at rank `r`, `m` at each of ranks `c,c+1`, and `mq` at every rank
  `c+j`, `2<=j<=q-2`.  Thus `F=Omega(W/q^3)` pairwise resource-disjoint
  frames would yield `Omega(W/q^2)` modules.  This frame packing is the
  exact conditional global input and is not proved.

  Under pointed-flag contraction, one module is exactly one `q`-edge and a
  frame is a conflict-free matching of `Theta(q)` such edges.  The base
  hypergraph has
  `D=(c+2)(c+1)(k-r)`, `Delta_2=c+1`, and
  `q^2 Delta_2/D->0`.  These statistics concern unrestricted single-module
  completions; they do not control correlated whole-frame patterns, the
  underlying resource-sharing conflict relation, or the two low ranks.
  Hence no global frame packing or growing-uniformity nibble conclusion is
  inferred.  SHA `1b335a4c8fdfc4da4bf44159f34f710c3c1486824e5418c999c971ea9741220e`.

# 2026-08-02 — Pointed-flag growing-nibble and named-resource conflict audit

- [MATH_AUDIT_FACET_POINTED_FLAG_GROWING_NIBBLE_AND_CONFLICT_BARRIER_20260802.md](MATH_AUDIT_FACET_POINTED_FLAG_GROWING_NIBBLE_AND_CONFLICT_BARRIER_20260802.md)
  independently verifies the pointed-flag contraction.  The `q`-uniform
  hypergraph is exactly regular with
  `D=(c+2)(c+1)(k-r)` and has maximum pair codegree `c+1`: adjacent
  flags have exactly `c+1` completions and nonadjacent flags at most one.
  Its internal star overlap is actually `O(q^-4)`, so the repository's
  growing-uniformity lemma gives one unconditional isolated bite.  An
  elementary greedy matching already supplies far more than `W/q^2`
  complete-flag-disjoint modules.

  This is not the required named-resource packing.  A fixed high target is
  contained in `Eq/K_s=exp(Theta(q log q))` module edges while the flag
  degree is only `Theta(q^6)`, so the resource-sharing pair-conflict degree
  is superpolynomial in the base degree.  Uniform sparsification preserves
  this bad ratio.  Gould--Kelly Theorems 1.4 and 1.6 have fixed-uniformity
  hierarchies and, for the plain flag hypergraph, the exact full-codegree
  bottleneck `B<=D^(1/(q-1))=1+o(1)` makes their conclusion trivial.  The
  explicit Alon--Bollobas--Kim--Vu growing-rank hypothesis fails
  exponentially.

  A product-like iteration also cannot be promoted to `Theta(q)` bites:
  after `s` bites a typical conditioned flag has residual completion degree
  `D(1-Theta(s/q^2))^((q-1)(q-2))`; at `s=Theta(q)` this is
  `q^(6+o(1))exp(-Theta(q))=o(1)`.  This is not a no-go for correlated
  constructions.  It identifies the live positive theorem as a correlated
  prime-slope frame/interval-spread packing, not a generic nibble.
  SHA `e61e6a407a443ca1b7ab0f2cf327c62a4aba95d9945b0cb59bf034f7647d07e3`.

  `1234` and `2413` have disjoint proper interval-set decks, so the two
  complete owner/target decks intersect in exactly the single rank-`(c+4)`
  target `C union {1,2,3,4}`. The two-frame coordinate budget follows from
  `2(q+q^2/8)-4<k-c` in the canonical range.

  Thus a frame collision need not have multiplicity `Omega(q)`: a global
  packing proof must control a genuine transverse singleton class. This
  refutes only the forced-clustering shortcut, not the frame-packing
  conjecture.

# 2026-08-02 — Facet low-rank Hall theorem and sharp affine obstruction

- [MATH_THEOREM_FACET_LOW_RANK_HALL_MULTIPLICITY_AND_AFFINE_LINE_COUNTEREXAMPLE_20260802.md](MATH_THEOREM_FACET_LOW_RANK_HALL_MULTIPLICITY_AND_AFFINE_LINE_COUNTEREXAMPLE_20260802.md)
  isolates the two low labels after an owner/high-simple facet-module
  packing.  An exact conditional Hall/Rado theorem first selects distinct
  targets `C_i+h_i` and then requires Hall for the compatible menus
  `(C_i-b)+w`, `w!=h_i`.  The robust multiplicity certificate is
  `Delta_H<=q` and `Delta_P<=c(q-1)`.  High simplicity by itself gives only
  `Delta_H<=floor((k-c-1)/2)` and
  `Delta_P<=floor(binomial(k-c,2)/2)`, which are polynomially too weak in
  the canonical regime.

  The first threshold is sharp inside the owner/high-simple class.  For
  prime-power `q>=4`, the `q(q+1)` affine lines of `F_q^2` over one common
  core have pairwise simple owners and high targets but only `q^2` possible
  rank-`(c+1)` targets; `Delta_H=Delta_P=q+1`, so for `c>=2` only the sharp
  H-row condition fails.  An explicit `q=4,c=5,k=16` counterexample uses
  twelve edge-disjoint four-cycles on eleven common tags.  It is minimal in
  the common-core four-cycle class, and its global scalar owner/target and
  primitive-coordinate rows are slack; only the independent buffer row must
  still be supplied.  Thus ledger feasibility and owner/high simplicity do
  not make the low rows automatic.  SHA
  `61da0158940870544ad5f854f57d5b0dc0a16b42b8ecfaa4901292358860ddcc`.

# 2026-08-02 — Fixed-base subset-core exponential amplifier

- [MATH_THEOREM_FACET_CODIMENSION_ONE_MARKER_FRAME_AMPLIFIER_20260802.md](MATH_THEOREM_FACET_CODIMENSION_ONE_MARKER_FRAME_AMPLIFIER_20260802.md)
  gives a literal local facet bundle much stronger than the prime-slope
  frame.  Partition `[k]=D dotcup G dotcup V`, with `|D|=a>=1`, `|V|=q`,
  and use every core `C_X=D union X`, `X in binom(G,c-a)`.  One common
  `beta in D`, cyclic order, and pair `w!=h in V` work for all modules:
  every owner and named target has `G`-intersection exactly `X`.  Hence all
  `M_a=binom(k-a-q,c-a)` modules are simultaneously owner- and
  target-simple, including both low rows.

  The construction is fully literal: every module is the sharp
  length-`q=d+2` cycle with one `P`, one primitive `H`, and `d` short `H`
  buffers, so all corrected source rows are multiplied by `M_a` rather than
  shared.  `M_a` decreases with `a`; the optimal singleton base has
  `M_1=binom(k-q-1,c-1)~2^{-(q+1)}e^{-pi/16}W`.  Thus a requested
  `Theta(W/q^2)` primitive inventory has the formal local quotient
  `Theta(2^q/q^2)` singleton-base frames, instead of `Theta(W/q^3)`
  prime-slope or `Theta(W/q^4)` singleton-marker frames.

  The same note proves this maximum-frame quotient cannot be packed with
  its common low labels.  A prelabelled `P` deck is the exact cylinder
  `A subset S`, `S cap F=empty`, with `|A|=a`, `|F|=q`.  For frames with one
  fixed `(a-1)`-base remainder, pairwise disjointness orients every pair of
  distinguished tags while every frame has outdegree at most `q`; hence
  there are at most `2q+1` frames per base and at most
  `(2q+1)C(k,a-1)` in total.  In particular `a=1` is globally impossible.
  The first base scale not excluded by this exact count is
  `a=(log 2+o(1))q/log q`—but an owner-cylinder theorem then gives the
  stronger no-go.  Whenever two bases satisfy
  `a_i+a_j+2q-2<=r`, disjoint complete frames require disjoint tag sets and
  one cross containment `V_i subset D_j` or `V_j subset D_i`.  Thus a
  uniform small-base family has at most `floor(k/q)` frames and carries only
  `O(qW/2^q)=o(W/q^2)` modules.  A complete-reservoir route would have to
  jump to base size `Theta(k)`.

  The viable partial-reservoir problem has an exact sparse language.  For
  any two fixed reservoirs, owner/high conflicts are a union of
  `q^2(q-2)` partial matchings; including the two low rows adds two.  The
  two-reservoir optimum is therefore bipartite matching/vertex cover, while
  for three or more reservoirs the exact resource packing is the displayed
  set-packing ILP.  Same-`D,V` order variants contain an identity owner
  matching, showing that internal reservoir simplicity and pairwise degree
  alone cannot accumulate the gain.  The current unconditional general
  extraction remains `W/(18q^3)` modules.  Source allocation, chronology
  and fusion remain open.  SHA
  `b910df31cc29d34589870d6de2b8ee1844194c65fbf4d838bab8436035d7ef6b`.

# 2026-08-02 — Fixed-base collision tensor, whole-frame no-go, and clustered pruning

- [MATH_THEOREM_FACET_FIXED_BASE_COLLISION_TENSOR_AND_WHOLE_FRAME_NOGO_20260802.md](MATH_THEOREM_FACET_FIXED_BASE_COLLISION_TENSOR_AND_WHOLE_FRAME_NOGO_20260802.md)
  gives the exact inter-frame collision tensor for the exponential
  fixed-base subset-core amplifier.  Every owner or named-target occurrence
  is a Boolean cylinder `Q_s(R,F)`, and two occurrence cylinders intersect
  in exactly

  `1[(R union R') cap (F union F')=empty] *`
  `binom(k-|R union R'|-|F union F'|,s-|R union R'|)`.

  This exact kernel changes the proposed global route.  For singleton-base
  frames, `r>=2q` and `k-r>=2` force every two intact frames to share a
  rank-`r` owner.  Hence the canonical asymptotic packing of
  `Theta(2^q/q^2)` whole frames is false; a proof must split frames and
  select proper module subfamilies.

  At `k=17,q=c=5`, one frame has exactly `binom(11,4)=330` modules and
  resource counts `330,330,1650,1650,1650` at ranks `5,6,7,8,9`.  Two
  frames avoid owner collisions iff their two six-coordinate supports are
  disjoint.  In that unique case they still share exactly
  `10,10,125,25,0` resources at those ranks, so no two intact reservoirs
  coexist and at least ten modules must be discarded even before the other
  collision rows are resolved.

  The exact bad-index anatomy gives a first partial extraction.  For two
  disjoint six-coordinate supports, all 170 cross-resource collisions are
  incident on exactly 50 module indices on either side, in four disjoint
  layers of sizes `10,10,25,5`.  Those layers also admit a 50-edge module
  matching, so Koenig's theorem makes the minimum deletion exactly 50.
  The optimal two-frame extraction is therefore exactly 610 modules.
  Consequently any three-frame attempt at 973 must use three pairwise
  intersecting six-coordinate supports; one disjoint pair caps the total at
  `610+330=940`.  The all-parameter bad-index count is formula (7.7).
  Conversely, any clustering which distinguishes frames only by disjoint
  exact traces on a common persistent-marker bank has aggregate size at
  most one frame, by Vandermonde; at `k=17` its ceiling is 330.  Reaching
  973 therefore requires row-correlated cylinder geometry across at least
  three/four frames, not more private marker bits.

  Asymptotically that row-correlated extraction is now proved.  Relative to
  another singleton frame with support difference `E=A'-A`, collision with
  one of its occurrence cylinders forces one exact trace
  `X cap E=R' cap E` of the first module core.  There are only
  `L=q^2-2q+2` such cylinders.  A fixed trace on `b` coordinates has
  probability `O(2^-b)`, while two random `(q+1)`-supports satisfy
  `E[2^|A cap A'|]=O(1)`.  Thus the mean bad-module count per ordered frame
  pair is `O(M_1 q^2/2^q)`.  Sampling `Theta(2^q/q^2)` frames and deleting
  every cross-bad module leaves `Omega(W/q^2)` completely labelled,
  pairwise owner/target-disjoint modules.  An independent proof stress-test
  passed all row, constant, moment and deletion-accounting checks.

  This closes the former factor-`q` named-resource packing gate at order
  scale.  It does not set an arbitrary leading constant, handle a protected
  bank, allocate primitive/short-buffer occurrences, serialize or fuse the
  modules, or establish upper/residence/compiler rows.  SHA
  `c5db41e006feba5f289d0264d6595b8e66be1700cb75369dea9f0790d6322c82`.

- [MATH_AUDIT_FACET_SINGLETON_RESERVOIR_CLUSTERED_PRUNING_EXTRACTION_20260802.md](MATH_AUDIT_FACET_SINGLETON_RESERVOIR_CLUSTERED_PRUNING_EXTRACTION_20260802.md)
  is the independent proof audit.  It checks the exact cylinder/trace
  normalization for every resource row, the absence of an extra
  first-start factor, the uniform `C 2^-b` trace estimate, the exact
  hypergeometric overlap moment, ordered-pair overcounting, duplicate-frame
  deletion, and
  `M_1~2^{-(q+1)}exp(-pi/16)W`.  Verdict: `GO` for the owner/named-target
  order-scale packing, with source occurrences, short buffers, chronology,
  upper/residence and compiler explicitly outside scope.

  It also proves a weighted protected-bank extension.  If
  `Psi=|D_c|/K_c+|D_(c+1)|/K_(c+1)+q sum_j|D_(c+j)|/K_(c+j)+q|D_r|/W`
  is bounded by a fixed constant below one, symmetry gives exactly
  `M_1 Psi` expected forbidden incidences per reservoir.  Reducing the
  frame-sampling constant therefore retains `Omega(W/q^2)` modules avoiding
  the bank.  This protects named resources, not source positions or
  compiler incidences.

  The audit further proves exact aggregate occurrence reservation.  With
  buffered-semigroup conductor `Q_(r,d)`, subtracting
  `t e_(d+1)+(q-1)t e_(d-1)` leaves an integrally decomposable residual for
  every
  `t<=min(A_(d+1)-Q-1,floor((A_(d-1)-Q-1)/(q-1)),floor((L-H)/d))`.
  This binds aggregate age types, not physical positions or component ports.
  The last row is a genuine scalar obstruction: when `L-H=o(W/q)`, the
  buffered family cannot supply `Theta(W/q^2)` modules, regardless of random
  support pruning.  SHA
  `f07202b2ea00e40762f994713cd74dd6bdcb2ff17b4f311af210008139104db0`.

  gives the weakest exact cutwise condition for a prescribed distinct-role

  labels.  A proper tight shore with equal forced-tail and head-role sets is
  an absolute component block.  Singleton-tail spanning sockets have zero
  charge and form an exact private absorber.  The theorem also proves the

  per coordinate, with average lengths `r` and `r-1`.  Deleting a coordinate
  turns its positive runs into an exact lower-rainbow Catalan linear forest;
  complementing its gaps gives an upper-completed Catalan forest.  The
  at-most-`2d` exceptional seams expose only `O(kd)` components, so all bulk
  residence is exactly a simultaneous balanced-component gate.  Marginal
  arithmetic permits positive and negative floor `d+1` for every odd

  the MSW minimum odd-graph factor gives an unconditional owner-once,
  exact-q1 two-factor of `Cat_(r-1)` wreaths: every coordinate has one run
  of length `r` and one gap of length `r-1` in every component.  Thus the
  balanced q1/residence factor exists in all odd dimensions; the remaining
  gate is resident upper-decorated fusion.  For one clean incidence-hexagon
  fusion, the note gives the exact capped prefix/suffix aperture criterion
  and the rigid aperture permutations; one seam has at most `2h-1` failed
  inequalities, but zero are required.  Consequently abstract plane-tree
  pull connectivity is strictly weaker than an accepting resident
  incidence hypertree.  For a frozen factor, the supported hexes through
  one incidence form a bipartite graph of maximum degree two and order at
  most `2(r-2)`.  The mountain MSW incidence
  `X subset X+infinity` has support zero in every semilength, disproving any
  uniform `Omega(r)` incumbent-list claim.  The complete H100 census through

  simultaneously positive/zero resident; even collision-free use of all

  residual perfect matching: every selected incidence, or one entire

# 2026-08-02 — exact K17 three-level common basis and socket branch--flow

- [MATH_THEOREM_K17_THREE_LEVEL_COMMON_BASIS_AND_SOCKET_NON_TU_BRANCH_FLOW_20260802.md](MATH_THEOREM_K17_THREE_LEVEL_COMMON_BASIS_AND_SOCKET_NON_TU_BRANCH_FLOW_20260802.md)
  identifies the exact static recoupling object.  On ground
  `E=M_7 disjoint_union R_8`, let `M_L` be the low-target receiver
  transversal and let `N=M_7^* direct_sum U_(16915,M)`.  Common bases of
  `M_L,N` are equivalent to exact no-singleton chain tables with histogram
  `(0,7395,16915)`.  Hence static root retirement and low receiver
  allocation are weighted two-matroid intersection, not arbitrary
  chronology search.
- A current root `b` is retired by the correlated common-basis exchange
  `B'=B-b+r`, `C'=C-r+b`; its two conditions are one rank7/root matching
  test and one low-receiver matching test.  Protected receiver data enter
  through deletion/contraction minors.
- Marginal socket positivity breaks the natural TU matrix.  The rows for
  one middle socket condition, one low source, and one root, on columns
  `y_lm,y_lr,x_mr`, contain the determinant-two matrix
  `[[1,0,1],[1,1,0],[0,1,1]]`.  Exact solving therefore uses the common

  successor conjugacy.  The familiar `Pack and holonomy` conjunction is

  property.  Every physical reset adapter is inside the packed connector

# 2026-08-03 — central-collar decorrelation and typed-socket cut

- [MATH_THEOREM_MACROSCOPIC_COLLAR_PARITY_DECORRELATION_20260803.md](MATH_THEOREM_MACROSCOPIC_COLLAR_PARITY_DECORRELATION_20260803.md),
  SHA `8e9e283811eb80016ee32eccf990f6ee12306172f1b209743c1db5a00e5ceecd`,
  proves that the critical flag-codegree surface is confined to a
  macroscopic central collar.  After peeling
  `a=ceil(c sqrt(r))` ranks for any fixed `c>sqrt(log 2)` and discarding an
  `o(W)` far tail, a parity-separated residual owner-flag law has uniform
  target degree `1-o(1)`, atom size `K=O(sqrt(r))`, and
  `rho_2=O(r^-2)`, hence `K^2 rho_2=O(r^-1)=o(1)`.  Every higher supported
  codegree remains an explicitly dominated flag codegree.
- The same theorem exactly chainizes the entire peeled collar by adjacent-
  rank Hall matchings into distinct middle owners, using at most `a` collar
  targets per owner chain.  These two constructions are not yet jointly
  coupled: a residual flag must lie below its particular collar bottom and
  use at most that owner's remaining `d-ell_T` slots.  Thus no integral
  `o(W)` matching, Ferrers cocycle, or additive upper bound is claimed.
  Independent audit
  [MATH_AUDIT_MACROSCOPIC_COLLAR_PARITY_DECORRELATION_INDEPENDENT_20260803.md](MATH_AUDIT_MACROSCOPIC_COLLAR_PARITY_DECORRELATION_INDEPENDENT_20260803.md),
  SHA `f85dadeef3dfee2e288a4fc76c1bf5f815657481e75de154604b081b01413e1a`.
- [MATH_AUDIT_MACROSCOPIC_COLLAR_GROWING_UNIFORMITY_MATCHING_THEOREMS_20260803.md](MATH_AUDIT_MACROSCOPIC_COLLAR_GROWING_UNIFORMITY_MATCHING_THEOREMS_20260803.md),
  SHA `2efff5ead52a036661ba66a42a95be95c7b6ed26902ca60c5f30791628b350c6`,
  checks the residual law against the available quantitative matching
  theorems.  Its full normalized codegree profile is
  `Delta_j/D <= (C_0/r^2)^(j-1)`, with the pair scale sharp.  ABKV fails
  exponentially; pair-only Vu/KKMO bounds are formally too weak.  The
  formal main powers in higher-codegree Vu and Gould--Kelly would give
  `o(W)`, but both the logarithmic losses and degree thresholds are
  nonuniform in the fixed edge size and therefore cannot be diagonalized at
  `K=Theta(sqrt(r))`.  Delcourt--Postle has the same fixed-rank boundary.
  Thus no published black box presently rounds this law to the required
  leave; a growing-rank laminar-flag theorem remains necessary.
- [MATH_THEOREM_CONTIGUOUS_COLLAR_STABLE_RESIDUAL_HALL_OBSTRUCTION_20260803.md](MATH_THEOREM_CONTIGUOUS_COLLAR_STABLE_RESIDUAL_HALL_OBSTRUCTION_20260803.md),

  empirical length law `Pr(L>=j)=binom(2r,r-j)/W`.  If the residual rank set
  is stable (in particular, one-parity) and obeys the pointwise capacity
  `|R|<=d+C-L` for fixed `C`, one explicit Hall row forces
  `Omega(sqrt(r))` missing rank mass, hence
  `Omega(sqrt(r) W)` uncovered named targets.
- The theorem also gives the exact weighted-Minkowski/Strassen criterion
  for arbitrary collar-length-conditioned stable residual laws.  Its

  [MATH_AUDIT_CONTIGUOUS_COLLAR_STABLE_RESIDUAL_HALL_OBSTRUCTION_INDEPENDENT_20260803.md](MATH_AUDIT_CONTIGUOUS_COLLAR_STABLE_RESIDUAL_HALL_OBSTRUCTION_INDEPENDENT_20260803.md),

- [MATH_THEOREM_FIRST_EXIT_TYPE_OBSTRUCTION_AND_THRESHOLD_HALL_20260803.md](MATH_THEOREM_FIRST_EXIT_TYPE_OBSTRUCTION_AND_THRESHOLD_HALL_20260803.md),

  proves that direct canonical acceptance is impossible: folded-C8 cross

- [MATH_THEOREM_EQUITABLE_CONFIGURATION_DP_JMS_BLACK_BOX_BOUNDARY_20260803.md](MATH_THEOREM_EQUITABLE_CONFIGURATION_DP_JMS_BLACK_BOX_BOUNDARY_20260803.md),

  audits the canonical labelled configuration host against the published

  has codegree `(1-o(1))D_*/(r+1)`.  The JMS ambient, degree, and codegree

  vanishing exponent and growing edge bound.  This is a direct-black-box
  no-go, not an obstruction to tailored sparsification or absorption.

- [MATH_THEOREM_SPARSE_TOP_SCD_FLAG_ROUNDING_AND_SINGLE_SCD_BARRIER_20260803.md](MATH_THEOREM_SPARSE_TOP_SCD_FLAG_ROUNDING_AND_SINGLE_SCD_BARRIER_20260803.md),
  SHA `f1381955ea94b2c5d86ec3af682d168228e86379a3dc66dad98b954388af89d1`,
  closes the complete named-target residual ideal below a

  their SCD chunks have total normalized top mass
  `2 sum_(j>=0) exp(-(7/8+sqrt(pi)j)^2)<1`, so one ordinary containment
  matching injects every literal chunk into a distinct middle owner.
  Flags have length at most `d`, contain no adjacent ranks, and arbitrary
  named boundary targets may be deleted afterward.  Conversely every
  construction that only splits one fixed SCD omits `Omega(W)` targets;
  true cross-SCD collar splicing is necessary.  Independent audit SHA
  `82b340a21b7f6644d32c0796407e363900a45d88c732aba9c20cfa2fe7d3077f`.
- [MATH_THEOREM_CROSS_SCD_CAPACITATED_ATTACHMENT_UNIT_BARRIER_AND_TOP_CAP_20260803.md](MATH_THEOREM_CROSS_SCD_CAPACITATED_ATTACHMENT_UNIT_BARRIER_AND_TOP_CAP_20260803.md),
  SHA `e3abe5f684f64f6c3eb89d17cdc4fe6e5d42a9e2103a56d44dfb97a64a26a2cd`,
  gives the exact Hall graph for attaching whole residual chunks below a
  fixed collar.  The current residual factor contains
  `(exp(-(7/8+sqrt(pi))^2)-o(1))W` full length-`d` chunks, while an exact
  collar has only `W/(r+1)+b_(r-1)=o(W)` empty owner slots.  Therefore
  `Omega(W)` chunks must be shortened or cross-spliced at exact depth.
  At depth `d+1`, every residual chunk can be matched through a distinct
  rank-`(r-1)` cap to a distinct middle owner.  This positive bridge covers
  only the top collar rank; ranks `r-a,...,r-2` remain open.  Independent

  `7ad8a0d5b46adeb1134991427aaaa0bd54255c06fa2bc88cea1d0ee39d5c4633`.
- [MATH_THEOREM_COLLAR_HOLE_MAJORISATION_AND_FIXED_SLACK_WHOLE_CHUNK_BARRIER_20260803.md](MATH_THEOREM_COLLAR_HOLE_MAJORISATION_AND_FIXED_SLACK_WHOLE_CHUNK_BARRIER_20260803.md),
  SHA `bb145cf2bbd92d7fed51151fdbc2c5d908e35dc5bc20e056451701711a3659ef`,
  strengthens the whole-chunk barrier by an exact Gale majorization.  If
  `H_j` is the hole count in collar rank `r-j`, every distinguished family
  of `A` owner rows must carry at least
  `L(A)=sum_j(A-H_j)_+` collar incidences.  The positive-density full-`d`
  residual rows have `L(A)=Omega(sqrt(r)W)`, so retaining those rows at
  depth `d+C` fails for every `C=o(sqrt r)`.  In the designated-row,
  remainder-preserving repair model, exports total at least `L(A)-AC`.
  This is not a lower bound against globally dissolving and rechainizing
  the residual bank.  Independent audit SHA
  `dd71c6fa1f1e5204cdcebf6724a644b746df8c15b2abd926f48f62c2f2f41180`.
- [MATH_THEOREM_ANTITONE_BALANCED_RESIDUAL_COLLAR_RANK_COUPLING_20260803.md](MATH_THEOREM_ANTITONE_BALANCED_RESIDUAL_COLLAR_RANK_COUPLING_20260803.md),
  SHA `86acaccf2dd701ae757bdb0b8fb2515083b1c54f867f82186a4b3b1b0ea5fe78`,
  proves the matching positive statement at anonymous rank-incidence level.
  Any residual bipartite-matching rank law and arbitrary collar columns can
  be decomposed jointly into `W` rows whose total loads differ by at most
  one.  Hence total mass at most `dW` fits at depth `d` exactly.  For a
  fixed residual load vector `h`, the exact required depth is the Gale
  maximum in formula (0.7); the equitable vector minimizes every collar
  cut simultaneously.  This identifies the whole-chunk failure as a bad
  load correlation, not scalar necessity.  Assigning anonymous rows to
  named owners and nested contained flags remains open.  Audit SHA
  `95ba096a89a34659001bd1d71d47b7cde82a729a2a1cd90ea0e77a0e5b28d51a`.

# 2026-08-03 — exact selector, converter, and `B+1` path interfaces

- [MATH_THEOREM_FIXED_FACTOR_RAINBOW_COMPLETION_HEADCOLOUR_HALL_AND_NONMATROID_GATE_20260803.md](MATH_THEOREM_FIXED_FACTOR_RAINBOW_COMPLETION_HEADCOLOUR_HALL_AND_NONMATROID_GATE_20260803.md),
  SHA `1a81158093019185be41d12012c5ae4287e971dc07119ddfe819107f7b6a25ed`,
  replaces "rainbow residual completion" by an exact two-stage integral
  master.  A one-per-colour base is a head-colour master satisfying its
  predecessor-fibre Hall cuts.  After fixing that base, the residual
  rainbow deficiency is `min_J max_X (|X|-|N_J(X)|)`, with the Boolean
  fibres explicitly given by the maps `p_R`.  The residual system is one
  transversal plus two crossing partition matroids; a minimal augmentation
  failure proves there is no generic Rado-matroid collapse.  The Boolean
  all-parameter Hall theorem remains open.  Audit SHA
  `7feee27b8fd495c2421e1b03d4cb207befbfc8177c9534fc7b15279975bf16c7`.
- [MATH_THEOREM_FIRST_EXIT_BOUNDARY_DIAMOND_CONVERTER_AND_FAN_DEPTH_BARRIER_20260803.md](MATH_THEOREM_FIRST_EXIT_BOUNDARY_DIAMOND_CONVERTER_AND_FAN_DEPTH_BARRIER_20260803.md),
  SHA `0524a427210c5e8c92b6ff550a8f88025a57fb5cbf390b4d7f68a028efd41412`,
  finds an exact zero-new-address Boolean diamond at every upper-run
  boundary.  It converts the native nested first-exit pair to an
  incomparable opposite-phase pair, but matches the canonical folded
  ticket only at `d=2,j=1`.  A general folded ticket needs exactly `d`
  Hasse edges and `d+1` values, with longest branch `max(j,d-j)`.  Hence no
  bounded-support Hasse/diamond converter survives growing depth; the
  exact-`B` first-exit route needs a full private fan or a nonlocal recoding.
  Audit SHA
  `c316edc3a12de59c183e782f9863721f00d2ae9a1ac6ee89dc23ea530614dae7`.
- [MATH_THEOREM_BPLUS1_PROTECTED_COMPONENT_PORT_HALL_AND_OCTAGON_HAMILTONIZATION_20260803.md](MATH_THEOREM_BPLUS1_PROTECTED_COMPONENT_PORT_HALL_AND_OCTAGON_HAMILTONIZATION_20260803.md),
  SHA `401aa24568e869909e332c61d222e72d6a0310c585168484e0b30267d6739392`,
  gives the exact topology min--max for a rooted Catalan forest.  If `B`
  is the protected free-component port graph, its Hall deficiency is the
  minimum path-component count; one path plus cycles exists exactly at
  deficiency at most one, while a direct Hamilton path is exactly Hall in
  some forward ordered port graph.  Port-preserving switches cannot repair
  deficiency greater than one.  At deficiency at most one, serial
  pivot-disjoint quaternary octagons absorb the remaining cycles under an
  explicit support hypothesis.  Audit SHA
  `2b612b1d7ff2b04a68e7ce25bdc4efd446c9465aa4c9984842b774a604518e90`.
- [MATH_THEOREM_BPLUS1_ALLWIDTH_RAINBOW_WITNESS_BANK_AND_SAFE_OPENING_20260803.md](MATH_THEOREM_BPLUS1_ALLWIDTH_RAINBOW_WITNESS_BANK_AND_SAFE_OPENING_20260803.md),
  SHA `f44ff6af870e6ef188444193e7c1755bb1441832f3a477a11bc0bda0505d5958`,
  makes arbitrary-width upper preservation exact.  A safe cut is a
  duplicated q1 provider outside the pivot and every target's forced-cut
  core.  On the rooted-forest face, retaining one witness for every higher
  target is equivalent to selecting a witness bank using at most one
  occurrence of every immediate-upper colour; making that support a forest
  adds one capacitated component-omission Hall system.  Ordered connector
  Hall then preserves the whole bank, and the monotone pivot itself is
  transparent at every width.  Existence of the rainbow witness bank is
  still open.  Audit SHA
  `cee21191163d10e46452d3a8eee72ed52b6743321f97630d771e4347808c05b9`.

# 2026-08-04 — pure-math exact-cut frontier for `B+O(1)`

- [MATH_THEOREM_CROSS_SCD_SPARSE_TOP_COLLAR_ATTACHMENT_20260803.md](MATH_THEOREM_CROSS_SCD_SPARSE_TOP_COLLAR_ATTACHMENT_20260803.md),

  `e22399cc4f64c0a338059b2ee7806d0c45c7d9b881a6f5d8f28e8a13457d33d2`.
- [MATH_THEOREM_EXACT_DICUT_REPRESENTATION_AND_GRAY_PREFIX_ONE_SHORE_NOGO_20260804.md](MATH_THEOREM_EXACT_DICUT_REPRESENTATION_AND_GRAY_PREFIX_ONE_SHORE_NOGO_20260804.md),

- [MATH_THEOREM_PAIR_CELL_TRACE_DECOMPOSITION_AND_ONE_TOUCH_RESIDENT_DICUT_NOGO_20260804.md](MATH_THEOREM_PAIR_CELL_TRACE_DECOMPOSITION_AND_ONE_TOUCH_RESIDENT_DICUT_NOGO_20260804.md),

- [MATH_THEOREM_TOUCH_NUMBER_BINARY_RESIDUE_AND_FACE_GLUE_GATE_20260804.md](MATH_THEOREM_TOUCH_NUMBER_BINARY_RESIDUE_AND_FACE_GLUE_GATE_20260804.md),

- [MATH_THEOREM_AFFINE_TRACE_VOLTAGE_FACE_GLUE_CONNECTIVITY_20260804.md](MATH_THEOREM_AFFINE_TRACE_VOLTAGE_FACE_GLUE_CONNECTIVITY_20260804.md),
  SHA `1a7e9a3b6bea7c26be7135d95d0400a255c4c789a044b8332a38bf21c550a7b3`,
  represents every pair-cell trace as an affine binary subspace and reduces

- [MATH_THEOREM_FIVE_SLOT_TWO_EFFICIENT_SMALL_PERIOD_WEDGE_CLOSURE_20260804.md](MATH_THEOREM_FIVE_SLOT_TWO_EFFICIENT_SMALL_PERIOD_WEDGE_CLOSURE_20260804.md),

- [MATH_THEOREM_LEAST_CRITICAL_ENDPOINT_THRESHOLD_NORMALIZATION_20260804.md](MATH_THEOREM_LEAST_CRITICAL_ENDPOINT_THRESHOLD_NORMALIZATION_20260804.md),

- [MATH_THEOREM_FIXED_THREE_RING_HAMILTON_COMPLEMENT_AND_SHARP_COMPONENT_RANK_20260804.md](MATH_THEOREM_FIXED_THREE_RING_HAMILTON_COMPLEMENT_AND_SHARP_COMPONENT_RANK_20260804.md),
  SHA `3159473442e72d5362af02ac7ff3270b87af4db128b00c0b0acda82a60579b57`,
  gives the exact complement formulation for the old 18-edge three-ring
  bank.  If the six transport hexes take a completion `F_0` to a Hamilton
  factor, their component--hex incidence multigraph is connected and has
  cyclomatic number `13-c(F_0)`.  Hence the six hexes form a strict
  component hypertree exactly at `c(F_0)=13`; for `c(F_0)<13` direct
  Hamiltonization is necessarily nonstrict.  The theorem also proves that
  arbitrary protected completions can have more than 13 components, so a
  component bound does not follow from protected extension alone.  This is
  now a sharp boundary theorem rather than the load-bearing `c=3` route.

- [MATH_THEOREM_SHARP_OPTIONAL_THRESHOLD_SHADOW_VIA_PARTIAL_SHADOW_20260804.md](MATH_THEOREM_SHARP_OPTIONAL_THRESHOLD_SHADOW_VIA_PARTIAL_SHADOW_20260804.md),
  SHA `90748e697d5dd10eb5b8a5cf35b849da16f73f6b188f6b3f589ec0e6e43e785b`,
  closes the formerly open one-sided Boolean threshold-shadow conjecture
  by an exact parameter translation to the Chao--Yu theorem resolving the
  Bollobas--Eccles partial-shadow conjecture.  If every upper set contains
  at least `D` selected facets and the upper shore is at least as large as
  the lower shore, then the lower shore has size at least
  `binom(2D-1,D-1)`; equality is uniquely a fixed-core lifted consecutive
  middle pair.  Strict side imbalance adds at least one.  Thus the optional
  core satisfies `|B^-|>=binom(2d-7,d-4)+1`, of order `4^(d-3)/sqrt(d)`.
  This greatly strengthens but does not eliminate the optional core.
  Self-GO parameter/equality/scope audit:
  [MATH_AUDIT_SHARP_OPTIONAL_THRESHOLD_SHADOW_PARTIAL_SHADOW_SELF_20260804.md](MATH_AUDIT_SHARP_OPTIONAL_THRESHOLD_SHADOW_PARTIAL_SHADOW_SELF_20260804.md),
  SHA `3f82ac19ea81ee5cc66d166d660df305065fda63bdb23cfc8ea1f4f48262fab3`.

- [MATH_COROLLARY_OPTIONAL_CORE_COORDINATE_SPAN_AND_LOCAL_CUBE_COVER_20260804.md](MATH_COROLLARY_OPTIONAL_CORE_COORDINATE_SPAN_AND_LOCAL_CUBE_COVER_20260804.md),

  converts the sharp optional-core cardinality into a localization barrier.

  generally, covering it by Boolean intervals of dimension `h` needs at
  least `ceil((binom(2d-7,d-4)+1)/binom(h,floor(h/2)))` intervals.  In

- [MATH_THEOREM_CORE_PINNED_WIDE_GAP_WALL_DESCENT_FOR_OPTIONAL_CORES_20260804.md](MATH_THEOREM_CORE_PINNED_WIDE_GAP_WALL_DESCENT_FOR_OPTIONAL_CORES_20260804.md),

- [MATH_THEOREM_UNIFORM_FORCED_FACET_SPREAD_ELIMINATES_OPTIONAL_CO_SMALL_CORES_20260804.md](MATH_THEOREM_UNIFORM_FORCED_FACET_SPREAD_ELIMINATES_OPTIONAL_CO_SMALL_CORES_20260804.md),

- [MATH_THEOREM_SCALAR_SLACK_PARITY_GRANULARITY_AND_EQUIDISTRIBUTION_20260804.md](MATH_THEOREM_SCALAR_SLACK_PARITY_GRANULARITY_AND_EQUIDISTRIBUTION_20260804.md),
  SHA `17ba23aa2b3e91d3bf8c80ba374589316d1cb12a8a253d376f42824387627be8`,
  gives one exact Wallis-quotient formula for both parities, the dyadic
  congruence `sigma congruent binom(d+1,2)+1 mod 2^(s_2(m)-1)`, and exact
  exponential Diophantine equations for every fixed slack value.  At fixed
  depth and parity there is at most one zero-slack dimension, and every
  fixed absolute near-zero range has only `O(sqrt K)` occurrences below
  `K`.  In the opposite direction, `sigma/W` has the uniform limiting
  distribution separately on each parity and
  `liminf sqrt(k) sigma/W=0`; hence no uniform positive fraction, or even
  `cW/sqrt(k)`, can be used as a rounding reservoir.  Polynomial relative
  lower bounds hold only on a density-one set.  The theorem consequently
  identifies the correct rounding target as the excess `D-sigma`, not a
  sublinear total duplicate count.  Self-GO arithmetic/asymptotic/scope
  audit:

- [MATH_THEOREM_COSELECTED_RESERVOIR_SMALL_CUT_CLOSURE_AND_PROTECTED_FACTOR_20260804.md](MATH_THEOREM_COSELECTED_RESERVOIR_SMALL_CUT_CLOSURE_AND_PROTECTED_FACTOR_20260804.md),

  common-core reservoir.  An inclusion-minimal deficient residual shore
  has at most one loose owner per vertex.  Outside the at most `2m^2`
  facets of deterministic top endpoints, the two spread-ten bounds force
  every selected vertex below at least `m-21` saturated unused owners;
  those owners are fewer than the shore itself.  Complementation and the
  Chao--Yu partial-shadow theorem then force every shore of size at least
  `4m^2` to have size `2^(1.377...m-o(m))`, contradicting the certified
  `2^(m+o(m))` small-side cutoff.  Below `4m^2`, Kruskal--Katona gives
  `|N(A)|/|A|>m/4`, while a pair-priced endpoint estimate gives
  `lambda_P(A)<=15|A|+min(2m,binom(|A|,2))`; these inequalities close the
  remaining range.  Combined with the independently audited uniform
  forced-facet optional CO-SMALL theorem, every residual Hall shore passes,
  so the protected reservoir extends to a spanning two-factor.  This does
  not connect its cycles or close chronology, global residence, upper-host,
  or compiler gates.  Self-GO minimality/threshold-shadow/KK/scope audit:

- [MATH_THEOREM_ROOTED_PATH_COVER_COEFFICIENT_ORDERED_HALL_AND_PULL_PARITY_20260804.md](MATH_THEOREM_ROOTED_PATH_COVER_COEFFICIENT_ORDERED_HALL_AND_PULL_PARITY_20260804.md),
  SHA `8b0f13778888218e1c35a2ff2d9f361690ea3174b960672cd06c960b3d0975db`,
  gives the exact same-factor topology gate after one perfect matching is
  contracted.  A second matching whose every factor cycle meets the hinge
  roots is bijective with an `R`-rooted spanning directed linear forest plus
  a root-to-unused-head closure matching.  Equivalently, one chooses an
  unused-head set and a topological order and checks two ordinary Hall
  systems; equivalently, a positive full-squarefree-head coefficient in a
  rooted matrix-tree polynomial times a root matching polynomial counts the
  valid factors exactly.  The natural integral object is a common base of
  the tail and head partition matroids which is also independent in a
  rooted graphic matroid; an explicit augmentation failure shows this
  three-way family is not itself a matroid.  A second-matching `C_6` has
  even component-rank change and cannot perform a binary merge, while a
  `C_8` is the first circuit length not ruled out from rank-one local action
  by the girth and parity of the Middle-Levels incidence graph (which has no
  `C_4`; the firstness is not a statement about arbitrary bipartite hosts).
  Hence the successful
  coherent binary `C_6` necessarily recolours both matching coordinates.
  Finally, for `m>=4`, the full successor graph outside any punctured-star
  common-core root set always contains a directed cycle: an acyclic host
  would force a residual degree-one upper vertex, but deleting the ring
  roots removes at most two facets of any owner.  Thus topology must remain
  correlated with the selected second matching; the theorem does not prove
  the required coefficient/Hall instance for the protected reservoir.
